exclusion_rule_X1: X1 REGIME/REVISION EXCLUSION RULE (C7-analog of STOCKS-NG4, frozen at P0 before any D2 diagnostic exists): (a) REGIME BOUNDARY — scored-candidate decisions use the disaggregated/TFF era only (2006-06-13 onward); legacy-era weeks (1986-01-15..2006-06-12) are census-only evidence and are excluded from any scored book and from cross-regime comparison (regimes parsed separately per A4). (b) REVISION CONFLICTS — any (futures code, report_date) whose parsed rows conflict within or across files under the declared hist-first precedence is excluded from books; conflicts are annotate-and-keep in coverage_census.json (part of this freeze). (c) A3 CORRECTIONS — a CFTC Special Announcement that alters USED-CODE position values excludes the named (code, report_date) rows; publication-delay and label-class items are annotate-and-keep with availability taken from evidenced publish dates. As of this freeze the served announcements (2023-2025) contain NO value-correction item touching a used code. (d) AVAILABILITY BASIS — report dates inside the rolling schedule window use evidenced schedule dates; the 2025-10..2026-01 federal-appropriations republication window uses the evidenced actual publish dates (15 report dates overridden, see a2_availability.json); ALL earlier scored-span report dates use the frozen convention model (Friday 15:30 ET, federal holiday -> next business day; decision = first 16:00-NY grid point strictly after the release instant) and are marked convention-based. A decision whose 16:00-NY grid point has no session on the entitled TD grid is DROPPED, never shifted. (e) PUBLICATION GAPS — weeks with no published report (gap census in coverage_census.json) produce no decisions; positions are never interpolated, carried forward, or backfilled. (f) POINT-IN-TIME — this rule and the folds freeze at the census commit; later source corrections apply only to post-freeze windows and NEVER re-open folds (plan A7).
